title: Memory atom frontmatter (markdown source)
description: Validates ONLY the YAML frontmatter block of a memory .md atom. The markdown body is intentionally NOT schema-validated — body shape is enforced by the curated-heading lint. additionalProperties:false makes stray metadata a hard author-time error. Exactly five fields (0.4.7 FR9): `category` was a hand-kept grouping whose only reader dropped `tldr` outside `core` — the catalog now carries `tldr` for every atom, and `area` (the atom’s directory) is the grouping that is derived rather than typed.

slug.description: Machine key; equals the filename stem, always — the ONE rule. Product atoms are lowercase-kebab; the three top-level docs are their uppercase stems (ARCHITECTURE, TECHSTACK, QUALITY). 0.4.7 FR9 deleted the alias table that mapped a lowercase slug onto an uppercase filename: a second slug-resolution mechanism, copied into three modules.

title.description: Human-readable atom title (used in catalog + panel).

tldr.description: One-sentence abstract; first-pass filter in the lean session payload.

summary.description: 1-2 sentence abstract; the 'should I self-pull this?' signal in the catalog.

tags.description: Free-form topic tags for catalog filtering.
